semiconductor_relevance: Medium — WOG Technologies provides critical water treatment solutions that support semiconductor manufacturing facilities in achieving environmental compliance and resource efficiency.
summary: WOG Technologies Limited offers specialized industrial wastewater treatment solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on sustainable and efficient systems. Their expertise includes the provision of water treatment systems for drinking, process, and ultra-pure water, as well as municipal and industrial wastewater solutions that facilitate reuse and ensure discharge compliance.
